answer: In this PoA design, an agent identity is bound to a remotely attested enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE) and a hardware-protected key, so copying a VM image cannot reproduce the identity or its signing authority. With enrollment enforcing one identity per eligible enclave, creating additional identities requires acquiring and attesting more physical silicon, not merely duplicating virtual machines. The pulse of fresh challenges, a prism of measurement checks, and quartz-like hardware roots help verify that binding.
